rows.en: (Chemistry's next, huh...)

Hey, \p...
Chemistry's next, right?
Yeah, it is. What about it?
...I forgot it.
Your assignment?

Yeah...
Sorry, but could I take a look at yours?

I don't mind, but...
there's no time, you know?
I'll manage on sheer willpower...

...Honestly, wouldn't it be faster to just
apologize to the teacher?

I guess you're right...
I'll go see the teacher...
(I'd better be careful too...)
(Chemistry's next...)
Yeah, it is. What about it?

I don't mind, but...
you won't have enough time, you know?

...Wouldn't it be faster to just
apologize to the teacher?
(I'd better be careful too...)
(Morning classes are over... I'm starving...)
\p, let's go get some food.

Sure, but Yuuto,
didn't you bring a lunch today?
I overslept, so I didn't make one.
Wait, you make your own lunches, Yuuto?
Yeah... Why?
I was sure your mom made them.
I may not look it, but I'm good at housework.

Come on, if we stand around chatting,
the school store will sell out.
Ah, wait for me!!
I'm leaving without you~
(I hope they haven't sold out~)

(Morning classes are finally over...
I'm so hungry...)

Sure, but Kagura-kun...
didn't you bring a lunch today?
Wait, you make your own lunches, Kagura-kun?

(Classes are over. Maybe I'll stop
somewhere on the way home.)
Isn't that... Hey, Yuuto!

Hm?
Oh, \p...

If you're free after school,
want to stop off somewhere?

Mom's working late today,
so I have to take care of things at home.
Oh right, it's just you and your mom, isn't it?

Yeah. Since Mom's out working for us,
I've got to handle the housework.
Then let's hang out some other time.

Ask me again sometime.
See you.
(Yuuto's got a lot on his plate, too.)
Isn't that... Hey, Kagura-kun!

If you're free after school,
want to go hang out somewhere?
(Kagura-kun's got a lot on his plate, too.)

(I've gotta have as much fun as I can
while summer break lasts...)

Hm, \p...
Out playing at this hour on a weekday?
Looks like you need to be taught a lesson.

Huh, Klan-senpai!
Um, it's summer break right now, so...
Hm, now that you mention it, so it is...

You're on summer break too, aren't you,
Klan-senpai?

Well, yes.
But I'm writing papers and such,
so I'm busy enough.
Huh~ College students sure have it rough.

Don't you go goofing off just because it's
summer break. Apply yourself to your studies,
a student's true duty!

Now, I must be off to the university.
I'll take my leave here. See you.
Okay, see you.
rows.notes: Shared with scd_com_207 and scd_fes_807 (player lines); neutral.

rows.en:
(Hmm, she may talk like a college student,
but Klan-senpai sure doesn't look like one.)

Hm, \p...
Out playing at this hour on a weekday...?
Looks like you need to be taught a lesson.

(Hmm, she may talk like a college student,
but Klan-senpai sure doesn't look like one.)

(When I think I'll get to see Sheryl soon,
I just can't stop grinning.)

What's with that giddy look,
\p?

Oh, Klan-senpai.
It's nothing, I'm just excited to see Sheryl.

Come to think of it, you Pilot Course students
are flying as part of the performance, right?

Yes, that's right.
Come and watch if you can.

I'd like to go and watch, but...
it's a concert by the Galactic Fairy herself.
There's no way I could get a ticket.

If it weren't for that,
I'd go watch Michel fly...
rows.notes: Muttered to herself; the player doesn't catch it (c17130).

rows.en: Huh? What was that?
N-nothing! See you!

(Klan-senpai looked embarrassed.
What was that about?)

(When I think I'll get to see Sheryl soon,
I just can't stop grinning.)

Yes, that's right!
Please come and watch if you can.

(Klan-senpai looked embarrassed.
What was that about, I wonder?)

uncertain: c17074/c17080/c17075: the chemistry teacher is unnamed; kept as neutral 'the teacher'.
c17129: Klan's aside about watching Michel fly read as muttered (the player asks 'what?' next).
